title: Karnataka Bank appoints Udaya Kumar Hebbar as MD & CEO for three years #Shorts
description:
Karnataka Bank has appointed Udaya Kumar Hebbar, former CreditAccess Grameen chief, as MD & CEO for three years. The appointment has RBI approval and is subject to shareholders' approval, as reported by Business Standard.

Sources: Business Standard
